column1: # Semantic FAMILIES — the role a capture plays, stated in each consumer's own
# vocabulary.
# ⚠ READ THIS BEFORE ADDING A ROW. This file does NOT contradict captures.md's
# "meaning is shared, appearance is per-editor". It relies on it.
#   COLOUR is per-editor and per-theme. Nothing here constrains a colour.
#   ROLE is meaning, and captures.md says meaning is shared.
# A family is the ROLE: "this is a constant", "this is a type". Each consumer
# expresses the same role in its own vocabulary — Emacs as a face, VS Code as a
# TextMate scope through semanticTokenScopes. The theme then picks the pixels.
# So when the two consumers put ONE capture in TWO families, they disagree about
# what the thing IS, not about how it should look. That is a meaning
# disagreement wearing an appearance costume, and it is what check-families.sh
# exists to catch.
# Why this gate exists: parity/check-parity.sh proves both consumers see the
# same CAPTURES. Nothing compared what those captures RESOLVE TO, so a shared
# capture could render as two different kinds of thing with every gate green.
# Found 2026-08-15 when keyword literals took string chrome in VS Code.
# Format:  family <TAB> emacs faces (space-separated) <TAB> vscode scope prefixes
# Matching is LONGEST PREFIX WINS on the VS Code side, so `variable.other.property'
# beats `variable.other'. An Emacs face is resolved through its `:inherit' chain,
# so a project face lands in the family of whatever it inherits.
# A family may be empty on one side. `namespace' has no standard Emacs face, and
# `parameter' has none either — Emacs offers no face that means "parameter" as
# distinct from "variable". An empty column means "this consumer cannot express
# this role", which is a real answer and NOT a licence to diverge: a capture
# whose two sides land in different families still fails. Record a deliberate
# divergence in known-gaps.tsv with consumer `family'.
# ⚠ EXACTLY ONE TAB between columns, and no alignment padding. Aligning with
# runs of tabs produced empty fields that shifted every column, and 19 of 21
# captures silently read as UNCLASSIFIED on this file's first run.
keyword
function
type
constant
string
number
comment
operator
namespace
property
variable
# `binding' covers BOTH a parameter and a pattern binder: each is a name being
# bound, which is one role. Longest-prefix matching keeps
# `variable.other.definition' here and plain `variable.other' in `variable'.
binding
modifier
warning
none
